scope: Independent stdlib-only source/AST/hash/ZIP and closed recipe-metadata review; no candidate code was imported or executed.

findings.problem: Both caller and strict-worker ResourceBudget() use the unchanged default 28*2**30 bytes (30064771072), with no separate worker1536MiB enforcement. This does not implement the root scope worker1536MiB/whole2048MiB caps inside the standalone archive.
findings.minimal_correction: Explicit2048MiB ResourceBudget cap in caller/child and explicit1536MiB worker-subtree RSS check; preserve denial/deadline/owned cleanup semantics. Label existing parent/self summed total as conservative sampled guard estimate, not exact whole-campaign RSS. Do not rewrite shared resource implementation.
findings.meaningful_prepared_cases: Synthetic over-limit caller total and worker RSS, exact allowed boundary, sticky denial and cleanup path; no fits.

findings.problem: A single dictionary target is counted but its membership is not enforced. For REG a stale/nonexistent declared target reaches unchanged validate_role_tables/discover, which fall back to another train-minus-test column. Discovery is checked only for kind/metric, so wrong target authority can be silently accepted.
findings.minimal_correction: Root-approved supported-release preconditions: valid/distinct declared names; target in TRAIN and not TEST; declared ID if present in TRAIN/TEST/SAMPLE; then require discovered target and ID equal the declared roles. Target name need not be a SAMPLE output column, preserving renamed output/probability schemas.
findings.meaningful_prepared_cases: Stale declared target with alternative train-only column must fail before discovery/worker; absent ID role member and discovered target/ID mismatch must stop.

findings.problem: Final output is always root/submission.csv, without rejecting identity with protected inputs/task/source. resolve_inputs resolves input symlinks. For example sample_submission.csv resolving to submission.csv makes publication overwrite the protected sample; only the post-replace fingerprint comparison detects it, after mutation.
findings.minimal_correction: Root-approved output identity preflight against all input/task/source/requirements paths before workers, repeated immediately before publication; reject symlink/canonical/same-file alias collisions and preserve unrelated files. Keep existing unique run-owned validated temporary publication and numerical behavior.
findings.meaningful_prepared_cases: Resolved alias to input or source stops before workers; a late destination alias stops before replace while an unrelated existing output remains unchanged on failed validation.

nonblocking_scope_limits: No historical Br/V16 metric transfers to this repackaged procedure; future two standard calls and independent saved-artifact R4 qualification remain required.
Prepared synthetic methods are source-reviewed only, not16PASS; no model/API/data or prediction-array execution occurred.
RSS is sampled and the existing root-self inspection conservatively double-counts parent RSS; it must not be called exact whole-run memory attestation.
Existing publisher plus unique run-owned temporary path and os.replace is not claimed to provide C01 fsync/CAS durability.
